english_explanation: China's Personal Information Protection Law gives individuals rights to consult, copy, correct, complete and, in the circumstances in Article 47, delete personal information. The law does not provide one universal response-day value for these requests, so provider-specific or later authoritative deadlines must be used. The linked CAC channel is a Chinese-language complaint route; it is always user-reviewed and never submitted automatically.

exceptions: The statutory exceptions referenced by Article 45 may apply.
rights.legal_basis: Personal Information Protection Law Articles 44 and 45
proof_requirements: Enough information for the personal-information processor to identify the person and relevant record.
rights.title: Consult and copy personal information

exceptions: The processor may verify whether the information is inaccurate or incomplete.
proof_requirements: Identify the inaccurate or incomplete information and the requested correction.
rights.title: Correct or complete inaccurate personal information

exceptions: Where a statutory retention period has not expired or deletion is technically difficult, processing must be limited to storage and necessary security measures.
proof_requirements: Identify the processor, account or record and the Article 47 circumstance relied on.
rights.title: Request deletion in specified circumstances
